description: AGSC-09-02: `conform` reports each required case that failed or was skipped as one finding with the code AGSC-E005 and severity error, and a withdrawn case, which counts for nothing (AGSC-00-16), and a passed case as none. The input is the result list of a run: a failed case, a skipped required case, a passed case and a withdrawn one that was skipped. The findings are the two for the failed and the skipped case, in the order of the results, and none carries the code AGSC-E001, which 1.0 used and which names an unknown verb. The exit code of the verb is 1 exactly when a finding exists.
